How we collect, use and protect your data.
The terms of membership and of using this website.
نحترم خصوصيتكِ، ونتعامل مع بياناتكِ الشخ:
We respect your privacy and handle your personal data in line with the Personal Data Protection Law of the Sultanate of Oman. This policy explains what data we collect, why we collect it, and how we protect it.

## The data we collect
- Sign-up details: your name, phone number, email address, and date of birth if you enter it.
- Membership details: your plan, membership dates, invoices and payments, class bookings, and your visits to the club.
- The messages you exchange with us on WhatsApp or through the contact form on the website.
- Basic technical data the website needs to work, such as the cookies that keep you signed in and remember your language.

## Why we use it
- To create your account and manage your membership and bookings.
- To issue invoices and confirm payments.
- To send service messages about your membership on WhatsApp: confirmation, renewal reminders and class times.
- To answer your questions and support requests.
- To send offers and news, only if you have agreed to receive them.

## Online payment
Online payments are made through the online payment gateway (Paymob). We never see your card details and never store them in our systems.

## Marketing messages
You can stop marketing messages at any time by writing «إيقاف» in the WhatsApp chat with the club. Service messages about your membership will continue.

## Sharing your data
We do not sell or rent your data. We share it only with the service providers we need to run the club, such as the payment gateway and the WhatsApp Business platform, and only as much as they need, or when the law requires us to.

## Protecting and keeping your data
Your data is kept on protected servers, and only the club staff who need it for their work can see it. We keep it for as long as you are a member, and afterwards for as long as financial records and the applicable regulations require.

## Your rights
You may view and correct your data in the member portal or by contacting us, ask us to delete it unless the law requires us to keep it, and withdraw your consent to marketing messages at any time.

## Contact us
For any question about this policy or your data, contact us from the Contact page of the website or on the club's WhatsApp.

We may update this policy from time to time, and the current version is always shown on this page.
باشتراككِ في النادي أو استخدامكِ لهذا ال:
By joining the club or using this website, you agree to the following terms.

## Membership
- Membership is personal and may not be transferred or shared.
- Your entry QR code or proof of identity is required at the door.
- Membership starts once payment is confirmed and ends on the date shown in the member portal.

## Prices and payment
- Prices on the website are in Omani rial and include what each plan lists.
- Membership fees are paid in advance, online through the payment gateway or at the club's reception.
- Discount codes apply under the terms and dates of each offer.

## Freezing, cancellation and refunds
- Membership can be frozen on plans that allow it, for the period the plan states.
- Cancellation and refund requests are reviewed under the club's policy available at reception, and the club will let you know its decision.

## Class bookings
- Classes are booked in the member portal, subject to available places.
- Please cancel early if you cannot attend, so someone else can take your place.
- The club may move or cancel a class when necessary, and will let you know.

## Health and safety
- Exercise within what suits your health, and ask your doctor if you have a health condition or are pregnant.
- Follow the trainers' instructions and the guidance for using the equipment.
- The club is not responsible for personal belongings not kept in the lockers.

## Conduct
We want a comfortable and safe place for everyone, and the club may suspend a membership for abuse or for breaking the club's rules.

## The website and your account
You are responsible for keeping your member portal password secret, and for the accuracy of the details you enter.

## Changes
The club may update these terms from time to time, and the version published on this page applies.

For any question, contact us from the Contact page or on the club's WhatsApp.
